raw_response: {"diagnosis":"80 EUR transactions are summed as if they were USD, because silver_transactions never applies currency conversion. raw_fx_rates has a rate for every currency present (EUR 1.25, USD 1.0), so silver can convert amounts to USD and the gold tables will follow.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount * f.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = r.currency WHERE r.status = 'POSTED'"}}
